questions: Does 'repeated value' mean exactly two occurrences of the same value, or could it be more than two (e.g., three identical numbers)?
Is the subarray required to be contiguous (as typical in 'subarray'), or can it be any subsequence?
If a repeated value appears multiple times across the array, should we consider only the minimal subarray containing the first two occurrences, or any pair of occurrences?
Are we allowed to use the same element twice as a 'repeated value' (e.g., a subarray of length 1)?
Should the output be the length of the subarray itself (number of elements), or the distance between the repeated indices?
If there are multiple shortest subarrays with the same length, is any acceptable output fine, or do we need to find one specifically?
Does the repeated value need to appear exactly twice within the subarray, or can other values also repeat?
Are there any constraints on time or space complexity that should guide the implementation approach?
